3. Fall back to searching through locals of previous frames

- `get_func_in_mro` looks up a function by code object in an object's MRO
- `get_locals_from_previous_frames` iterates through locals of all previous frames

1. Check if there's a `self` or `cls` in the frame's locals (instance/class methods)
